convertibility_reason: Martingale position sizing with margin-dependent lot escalation and recursive loss recovery logic requires MT5 account state tracking; grid-like position stacking on losing trades makes Python conversion unreliable for backtesting accuracy

other_exits: Close all on target profit reached (account-level equity target)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Initial lot is fixed; after a losing trade, lot size is multiplied by the martingale factor; resets to initial lot on win

custom_logic_notes: Martingale lot escalation: on each consecutive loss, lot size multiplies by configurable factor (default 2x). EA tracks last trade result; if loss, next trade uses multiplied lot; if win, lot resets to initial. Equity target close-all logic may be present. No hard stop loss — relies on martingale recovery and optional account-level profit target to exit. Position stacking possible as martingale may add to existing direction.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale sizing requires full account state simulation (balance, equity, margin) per trade. Lot escalation and reset logic must faithfully track consecutive wins/losses. No SL means drawdown can be extreme — backtest must model margin calls. Signal is simple (CCI cross of ±100 levels), but money management dominates the strategy behavior. Recommend tick data for accuracy since TP is fixed-pips and exit timing matters for martingale reset.
